task.purpose: Introduce an unknown visual-direction product in a social feed.
task.output_context: Horizontal feed image with a 160-pixel thumbnail check.

proposition.primary_message: A vague visual impulse can become a controlled authored image.
proposition.desired_response: Recognize the name first, then discover the narrative tension.

strategy.selected_direction: Editorial title plus restrained cinematic narrative.

observable_pass_conditions: The product name is readable at 160 pixels wide.
The reference mechanisms remain without copying its subject or layout.
user_judgment_required: Whether the narrative still feels authored rather than generic.
